prompts.pneuma_logo:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Deliver ONE finished FurinaChronicle transparent character mascot logo, a clothing-accurate revision of input 1. NOT a reference sheet, NOT a full-body render.
Input 1 = the user's PREFERRED existing TRANSPARENT mascot v3: master for adorable chibi proportions, FACE, calm tiny smile, inverse-color droplet pupils, pose, clean sticker rendering, OPEN BOOK AND WRITING QUILL.
Input 2 = actual front render of the specific costume variant: authority for costume geometry and placement.
Input 3 = actual body UV texture atlas: authority for lapels, fabric patterns, ornaments and costume colors.
Input 4 = actual hair/hat/glove/iris texture atlas: authority for gold hat components, both gloves, ribbons, and eye pattern. UV atlas patches are material references; don't draw an atlas or paste patches in the logo.
Additional reference if present is explicitly described below.

Keep the preferred input-1 identity, face, hairstyle at front, relaxed expression, large cute head, smooth navy outlines, clean soft cel shading, pearl/cyan hair and watercolor-free 2D official chibi-sticker aesthetic. Preserve the writing pose: anatomical RIGHT hand on VIEWER LEFT with BLACK glove holding ONE white feather quill, nib touching the left half of the journal; anatomical LEFT hand on VIEWER RIGHT with WHITE glove resting on open book. Keep book cover cobalt/navy, ivory pages with two blue written strokes, restrained gold corners and bookmark. The connected character-and-book silhouette is the brand.

REPLACE inaccurate generic clothes with the ACTUAL model clothing translated carefully into chibi form. Don't hide the costume behind an oversized invented bow. Slightly open the space between chin and book so the upper torso, collar, cravat, lapels and small side brooch can really be seen, while maintaining the beloved face and overall chibi logo feel. Not a full body. No legs.
Accurate common details:
- Black upright throat collar with small crisp pale pointed collar tips.
- Under central throat jewel, a layered dark blue ruffled JABOT / cravat with two or three scalloped tiers, NOT A LARGE NECK BOW.
- Central gold-framed BLUE TEARDROP jewel with a small pale-gold curved water motif INSIDE the blue drop, plus a small dangling gold rhombus.
- Royal blue fitted outer tailcoat with proper V-shaped lapels and small paired gold buttons.
- Asymmetry: on anatomical LEFT chest / VIEWER RIGHT, a SMALL cobalt ribbon bow bearing a gold star/flower-shaped rosette with round blue center and tiny hanging pale-gold drop. This SMALL SHOULDER/CHEST ornament is separate from the central neck jewel.
- Anatomical RIGHT chest / VIEWER LEFT has a small narrow gold-edged pale-blue drop/leaf ornament, not a matching rosette.
- Sleeves have broad flared deep navy cuffs with stylized gold fleur-de-lis / curling lyre-like trim; ruffled blue edging near wrists. Both wrists must visibly show designed cuffs rather than plain gold triangles.
- BLACK right glove and WHITE left glove are slender fitted fabric gloves, not puffy mittens. Show simplified finger seams and actual small glove-back details from atlas: small pale-gold diamond motif on black glove where visible, faint pale droplet motif on white glove; a blue diamond jewel and gold-edged cuff trim where visible. Never recolor both gloves the same.
- Refine HAT from the oversimplified round ball crown into the model's cobalt top hat: deep blue round brim, cobalt blue band, a few slender gold ornamental keyhole/dagger-shaped crown arches with hollow teardrop tops and tiny pearl finials, two/three small hanging BLUE WATERDROPS beneath gold segments. Gold geometry is delicate but clearly drawn, not chunky cartoon crown spikes ending in giant balls. At the side on VIEWER RIGHT, bow and plume cluster per variant. Remove the invented giant central gold-framed tear on hat brim; use appropriate small side decoration instead.
- EYES keep exact v3 inverse-color arrangement: VIEWER LEFT pale icy iris with dark-blue upright pointed WATERDROP pupil; VIEWER RIGHT deep royal-blue iris with pale cyan upright WATERDROP pupil and a thin lavender/purple outer iris ring. Keep small white round highlights at bottom and fine short lateral iris glints. No generic oval pupils.
Simplify minute seams tastefully but KEEP the recognizable feature hierarchy and asymmetry above. White/light and dark/black costumes remain blue outer jackets; don't recolor all of Furina white or black.
Composition: compact centered mascot logo, complete curl, hat, quill, hair and book contained with comfortable clear padding. Match original preferred transparent mascot proportions as closely as practicable, with slightly more visible torso. Thin clean pearl sticker keyline. Use clean continuous contours and no detached pixels or speckles.
Actual fully transparent alpha background, no colored background, no badge shape, no fake checkerboard, no scene. No text, lettering, title, watermark, extra characters or props. One final complete logo.
SPECIFIC VARIANT: PNEUMA / 芒性, WHITE THEME WITH LONG HAIR.
Input 2 is the light/white costume model front render. Input 3 is 体.png, the light clothing atlas. Input 4 is 髮.png, the matching hat/glove/eye atlas. Input 5 is 髮2.png, the extra LONG HAIR atlas present in this model but absent from the Ousia model.
Crucial: preserve short face-framing bob AND ADD THE TWO LONG SILVERY-WHITE BACK HAIR TAILS which flow from behind both shoulders down to just above/beside the book's bottom edge, with pale icy-blue undersides. These are HAIR locks with strand separation, not costume coattails, ribbons, a cape or a white scarf. Make the extra length unmistakable in the compact bust silhouette, in two controlled graceful outer curves, without enlarging the silhouette wildly.
Use pearly WHITE broad lapels and WHITE waistcoat front visibly framed by cobalt tailcoat. High collar/cravat remain dark blue. Use white fabric in hat side plume/ribbon accents on viewer right, as in light model render. Gold ornaments remain antique light gold. Not an entirely white suit.

prompts.pneuma_rounded_icon:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserve / logo-brand.
Deliver ONE finished rounded-square APP ICON, not a mockup.
The sole input is the FINAL APPROVED CLOTHING-ACCURATE transparent FurinaChronicle character logo for this costume. Treat this mascot as a locked illustration insert. Keep its face, waterdrop pupils, lavender iris rim, hair length, precise costume ornaments, gloves, hat, book, quill, colors, pose and drawing style EXACTLY as provided. Do not substitute an earlier drawing, redesign features or crop any part of the mascot. It is the favorite transparent mascot artwork, placed on an app-icon tile.
Layout: exact 1:1 SQUARE output canvas, 1024x1024 or larger. A large solid ROUNDED SQUARE background tile, with four equal smooth corner arcs of radius 20% of tile width. Tile covers entire canvas width and height except the actual transparent corners outside those curves. Corners OUTSIDE rounded square MUST BE TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT, not white and not a checkerboard picture. Inside tile is opaque. No drop shadow extending outside tile. Keep the underlying canvas square; don't tightly crop to the character.
Uniformly scale the entire input mascot down to fit within central 78% width and 86% height of tile, preserving source proportions, all hair and hat and quill and book inside rounded tile with breathing room. Center vertically and horizontally. NO overlap beyond tile. Keep fine clean pearl sticker keyline around mascot but REMOVE every detached white speckle or fringing artifact from original transparent master before placing it. No extra decorative shapes, stars, patterns, symbols, lettering, app name, labels, watermarks, or alternate copies. No perspective, no 3D app mockup. Just one usable flat icon PNG with rounded background and true alpha corners.
Variant: PNEUMA / 芒性 white-theme costume. Preserve the TWO LONG SILVERY WHITE BACK HAIR TAILS around the shoulders and book, white lapels and waistcoat, white hat feather. Background tile: refined pale icy-blue #CFE6F7 near edges softly illuminated toward pearl #EDF6FF at center, subtle and quiet, no texture, so the royal-blue outer jacket and gold details are readable. The actual outfit still has a cobalt outer jacket; do not whiten it. Keep contrasting navy contour on white hair.
